name: Kobonnou na Ryousai Kenbo ga Part Saki de Toshishita Ikemen Joushi ni Otosareru made no Kiroku The Game
original_name: 子煩悩な良妻賢母がパート先で年下イケメン上司に落とされるまでの記録 ザ・ゲーム
source:
Convenience store employee Matsuhiro Sakurai is always getting called out by his best friend, Officer Kazuma Shinozaki, and he's got a problem.
He's got absolutely no experience in the bedroom!

Even though he sees hot women all over the place, he just can't make it work. Why?

He gets so nervous when he meets or talks to women...

He never thought his life would turn out like this...

He'd just about given up...

Until his friend Kazuma's mom comes to work at one of his stores....

When he was young, he told himself he'd marry a girl like his friend's mom one day.
She was his first crush. Not only that, she's the wife of a highly respected police commissioner.
Why is she working at a convenience store?

When she's not doing so well, though, she needs Matsuhiro's help.
And the distance between them finally closes...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ305124.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
